name: Camp Cedar
description_short: Overnight summer camp in Casco, Maine. For 2027 it offers a full session (June 27–August 13) and shorter 4- and 5-week sessions.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: No prices appear on the 'Dates + Rates' page. There is another page at https://campcedar.com/dates-rates/ that may list rates, possibly for a different year.
The footer says ©2023, but the page lists 2027 dates. Check the dates with the camp.
The page also lists Rookie Day for prospective campers (Thu July 22), Visiting Day (Sat July 24) and a Father & Son Overnight (Aug 13-14). These are events, not bookable sessions.
The winter office is at 1758 Beacon Street, Brookline, MA 02445-2124, (617) 277-8080. The camp itself is in Casco, ME.
